title: Use a workflow of Idea/Image → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 →…
content: Use a workflow of Idea/Image → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 → prompt to turn one idea into a structured visual sequence and then generate the video in Seedance.
tips: Use a workflow of Idea/Image → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 → prompt to turn one idea into a structured visual sequence and then generate the video in Seedance.

es.content: Usa un flujo de trabajo de Idea/Imagen → storyboard de Custom GPT Image 2.0 → Seedance 2.5 → prompt para convertir una idea en una secuencia visual estructurada y luego generar el video en Seedance.

fr.content: Utilisez un workflow allant de l’idée/image → storyboard Custom GPT Image 2.0 → Seedance 2.5 → prompt pour transformer une idée en séquence visuelle structurée, puis générez la vidéo dans Seedance.

ja.content: アイデア／画像 → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 → prompt というワークフローを使って、1つのアイデアを構造化されたビジュアルシーケンスに変換し、その後 Seedance で動画を生成します。

ko.content: 아이디어/이미지 → Custom GPT Image 2.0 스토리보드 → Seedance 2.5 → prompt를 사용해 하나의 아이디어를 구조화된 비주얼 시퀀스로 전환한 다음, Seedance에서 영상을 생성하는 워크플로를 사용하세요.

pt.content: Use um fluxo de trabalho de Ideia/Imagem → storyboard do Custom GPT Image 2.0 → Seedance 2.5 → prompt para transformar uma ideia em uma sequência visual estruturada e, em seguida, gerar o vídeo no Seedance.

zh.content: 使用一个工作流程：Idea/Image → Custom GPT Image 2.0 storyboard → Seedance 2.5 → prompt，将一个想法转化为结构化的视觉序列，然后在 Seedance 中生成视频。
